description: R.A.Y.S. Ramani v. W.S. Jayasooriya and Another R.A.Y.S. Ramani v. W.S. Jayasooriya and Another View More before Hon. Eric Basnayake, J.
parties: R.A.Y.S. Ramani v. W.S. Jayasooriya and Another R.A.Y.S. Ramani v. W.S. Jayasooriya and Another View More
keywords: Leave to Appeal; The Petitioner challenged the District Court’s ruling that it had jurisdiction to hear an action concerning the width of a roadway without a Mediation Board certificate. Held - where the parties had already invoked the Primary Court’s jurisdiction and an order had been made under Sections 68 or 69 of the Primary Courts Procedure Act, a separate certificate under Section 7(1) of the Mediation Boards Act was unnecessary. Appeal dismissed with costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka; Mediation Boards Act No 72 of 1988
